Forward Deployed Engineer
📍 United States | Remote with frequent travel to customer sites
💰 $150,000–$240,000 base salary + equity
We're working with a venture-backed AI business looking to hire a Forward Deployed Engineer to build and deploy production AI solutions for enterprise customers.
Key Responsibilities
Build production LLM workflows, RAG pipelines and agentic systems.
Build evaluations to assess accuracy, reduce hallucinations and maintain reliability as usage scales.
What We're Looking For
Typically 3–7 years of software, full-stack, applied AI or forward-deployed engineering experience.
Based in the US, able to travel frequently and ideally located near a major airport. Chicago-based candidates are particularly welcome.
Authorised to work in the US without visa sponsorship.
